name: auto-work
description: Windows 本机多项目研发、周报与绩效管理工作台

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @auto-work/contracts build && pnpm --filter @auto-work/domain build && pnpm --filter @auto-work/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @auto-work/web typecheck
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json apps packages scripts/release README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json apps packages scripts/release README.md
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
